nodes.summary: In a labelled transition system with a silent label $\tau$, if $p$ and $q$ are rooted weakly bisimilar and there is a rooted weak transition from $p$ to $p'$ with label $\mu$, then there is a state $q'$ with a rooted weak transition from $q$ to $q'$ with label $\mu$ such that $p'$ and $q'$ are weakly bisimilar.
nodes.title: Observation congruence matches rooted weak transitions

nodes.summary: In every labelled transition system with a silent label $\tau$, rooted weak bisimilarity (observation congruence) is reflexive, symmetric and transitive.
nodes.title: Observation congruence is an equivalence relation

nodes.summary: In a labelled transition system with a silent label $\tau$, any two strongly bisimilar states are rooted weakly bisimilar.
nodes.title: Strong bisimilarity implies observation congruence

nodes.summary: In a labelled transition system with a silent label $\tau$, every transition $s \xrightarrow{\mu} t$ is a rooted weak transition from $s$ to $t$ with label $\mu$.
nodes.title: Transitions are rooted weak transitions

nodes.summary: In a labelled transition system with a silent label $\tau$, if $s$ reaches $m$ by zero or more $\tau$-transitions and there is a rooted weak transition from $m$ to $t$ with label $\mu$, then there is a rooted weak transition from $s$ to $t$ with label $\mu$.
nodes.title: Silent steps before a rooted weak transition

nodes.summary: In a labelled transition system whose labels include a silent label $\tau$, there is a rooted weak transition from $s$ to $t$ with label $\mu$ when there are states $s_1$ and $s_2$ such that $s$ reaches $s_1$ by zero or more $\tau$-transitions, $s_1 \xrightarrow{\mu} s_2$ is a transition, and $s_2$ reaches $t$ by zero or more $\tau$-transitions. In particular, a rooted weak transition with label $\tau$ contains at…
nodes.title: Rooted weak transition

nodes.summary: In a labelled transition system with a silent label $\tau$, states $p$ and $q$ are rooted weakly bisimilar (observation congruent) when every transition $p \xrightarrow{\mu} p'$ is matched by a rooted weak transition from $q$ to some $q'$ with label $\mu$ such that $p'$ and $q'$ are weakly bisimilar, and every transition $q \xrightarrow{\mu} q'$ is matched by a rooted weak transition from $p$ to some $p'$ with…
nodes.title: Rooted observation congruence

nodes.summary: In a labelled transition system with a silent label $\tau$, any two rooted weakly bisimilar states are weakly bisimilar.
nodes.title: Observation congruence implies weak bisimilarity

nodes.summary: In a labelled transition system with a silent label $\tau$, every rooted weak transition from $s$ to $t$ with label $\mu$ is a weak transition from $s$ to $t$ with label $\mu$, where a weak transition with label $\mu$ is either the trivial step from a state to itself with label $\tau$, or a transition with label $\mu$ preceded and followed by zero or more $\tau$-transitions.
nodes.title: Rooted weak transitions are weak transitions

nodes.summary: In a labelled transition system with a silent label $\tau$, if there is a rooted weak transition from $s$ to $m$ with label $\tau$ and a weak transition from $m$ to $t$ with label $\mu$, then there is a rooted weak transition from $s$ to $t$ with label $\mu$. Here a weak transition with label $\mu$ is either the trivial step from a state to itself with label $\tau$, or a transition with label $\mu$ preceded and…
nodes.title: A rooted silent step followed by a weak transition is rooted

nodes.summary: In a labelled transition system with silent action $\tau$, if there is a rooted weak transition from $s$ to $m$ with label $a$, and $t$ is reachable from $m$ by zero or more $\tau$-transitions, then there is a rooted weak transition from $s$ to $t$ with label $a$.
nodes.title: Appending silent steps to a rooted weak transition

nodes.summary: In a labelled transition system with silent action $\tau$, if $p$ is rooted observationally congruent to $q$ and $q$ is rooted observationally congruent to $r$, then $p$ is rooted observationally congruent to $r$.
nodes.title: Transitivity of rooted observational congruence

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
